channel.title: GA on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in GA on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Large OS Disk Encryption for Azure Confidential VM migrations
item.description:
Large OS Disk Encryption (LOSDE) is now generally available for Azure Confidential VM migration scenarios. It enables migration of larger production workloads with the OS disk fully protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: HTTP DDoS ruleset for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Microsoft announced general availability of the HTTP DDoS ruleset for Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) on Azure Front Door Premium. The update adds HTTP-layer DDoS protection to help reduce application downtime from volumetric web attacks.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure MCP Server 3.0
item.description:
Azure MCP Server 3.0 is now generally available. The release expands Azure integration for AI agents and developer tools via the open Model Context Protocol (MCP), including new infrastructure-as-code support through Azure Terraform.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Fusion is now generally available. It lets users choose Fusion instead of selecting a model per task, and Copilot will route and orchestrate which models to use automatically.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Agentic Workflows generally available
item.description:
GitHub Agentic Workflows is now generally available. It can be used to automate reasoning-based tasks such as issue triage, CI failure analysis, and documentation updates.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Higher limit of Azure Blob Storage accounts per region per subscription
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage account quotas are now generally available at up to 1,000 standard-endpoint storage accounts per region per subscription, increased from the default 250. This allows more storage accounts to be managed within a single subscription.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium now supports generally available WAF policies at the profile and route level, instead of only at individual domains. This allows broader baseline protection across an entire Front Door profile or selected routes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Network Watcher VNet flow logs filtering
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher VNet flow logs filtering is now generally available. It lets you limit logged network traffic using criteria such as IP addresses, ports, protocols, encryption state, flow state, and traffic direction.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Item Level Recovery for Azure VMs with Premium SSDv2 and Ultra Disks in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports item-level recovery for Azure VMs using Premium SSD v2 and Ultra disks, including both 512-byte and 4KB logical sector sizes. This lets you recover individual files and folders from these VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage
item.description:
ABFS Vectored Read is now generally available for Azure Data Lake Storage. It reduces request overhead for selective reads by batching nearby file ranges into fewer asynchronous storage requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation is now generally available. It adds timestamp metadata for when each account key was last used, which helps identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Keyless TLS on Application Gateway with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now supports keyless TLS termination with certificates stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM. During TLS handshakes, signatures are performed inside the HSM and the private key is not exported to the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Metrics usage insights for Azure Monitor workspace
item.description:
Metrics usage insights for Azure Monitor workspace is now generally available. It provides visibility into workspace metrics usage, including utilization, unused metrics, usage trends, and changes driving usage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DNS enables DNS-based load balancing through Traffic Manager linked records
item.description:
Azure DNS now supports DNS-based load balancing by linking a DNS record set directly to an Azure Traffic Manager profile. This removes the need to use a CNAME record pointing to Traffic Manager.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Browser automation tool in Microsoft Foundry is now GA
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s browser automation tool is now generally available. It adds managed browsers, native toolbox integration, Live View, and human-in-the-loop control for automating tasks on public and private websites.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
External key management for Azure Key Vault Managed HSM is now generally available in all Azure public regions. It allows organizations with regulatory or sovereignty requirements to keep physical control of key-encryption keys while using Azure services that support this capability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Standard service endpoint
item.description:
Azure introduced Standard service endpoint as a generally available capability in the Azure Private Link family. It is designed to provide a scalable, secure way to connect Azure IaaS workloads to Azure PaaS services, addressing manageability and scale limitations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Availabile: Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets
item.description:
Automatic zone balance for Virtual Machine Scale Sets is generally available. It continuously monitors scale sets across availability zones and redistributes VM instances when zonal imbalances are detected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server in East US 3
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server is now generally available in the East US 3 Azure region. The update announces regional deployment availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Anyscale on Azure
item.description:
Anyscale on Azure is now generally available. It is a managed platform for running distributed Python workloads on Ray, deployed directly on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and integrated with Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Stacked pull requests generally available
item.description:
GitHub stacked pull requests are now generally available. The feature lets you split large changes into smaller, focused pull requests that can be reviewed independently and merged together.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Bleu
item.description:
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines is now generally available in Azure Bleu. This lets customers deploy and manage SQL Server workloads in France’s sovereign cloud while meeting data residency and sovereignty requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap
item.description:
Kubernetes node swap is now GA in v1.34, and this post reports that using fast NVMe Local SSDs for swap can raise pod density for memory-heavy workloads with little latency impact when active working sets remain in RAM.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Storage optimized Lasv5 and Laosv5 Azure VM series
item.description:
Azure has generally available Lasv5 and Laosv5 storage optimized VM series, based on 5th Gen AMD EPYC (Turin). The series offers 2–160 vCPUs, 8 GiB memory per vCPU, and 720 GB of local NVMe disk per vCPU.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server in Germany West Central
item.description:
Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server is now generally available in Germany West Central. It lets you connect SQL Server instances to Azure Arc for inventory, governance, security, assessment, and license management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server Available in Italy North
item.description:
Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server is now generally available in the Italy North region. Customers can connect SQL Server instances to Azure Arc to use Azure-based inventory, governance, security, assessment, and license management features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added larger Hyperscale Premium compute options in Azure SQL Database, including 160-vCore and 192-vCore SKUs. Microsoft says these provide up to 50% more compute capacity than the previous top tier.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server supports cross-tenant customer-managed keys (CMK)
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now supports cross-tenant customer-managed keys (CMK). Data can be encrypted with keys stored in an Azure Key Vault or Azure Managed HSM in a different Microsoft Entra tenant than the PostgreSQL server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Server on Azure Local Disconnected (ALDO)
item.description:
Azure Local Disconnected (ALDO) for SQL Server is now generally available. It extends SQL Server support to disconnected environments that cannot maintain continuous Azure connectivity, including regulated, secure, remote, and air-gapped deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: SQL Migration Agent Skills for assessment, migration, and validation
item.description:
SQL Migration Agent Skills are now generally available to help automate SQL Server to Azure migrations. They provide reusable AI-powered skills for assessment, target selection, migration execution, and post-migration validation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Support for large volume breakthrough mode
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files large volume breakthrough mode is now generally available. It adds support for volumes up to 2 PiB and throughput up to 80 GiB/s, depending on workload characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Storage with cool access enhancement
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files now supports QoS updates with cool access enabled on Premium and Ultra service levels, improving how performance and cost are balanced for mixed hot and cool workloads. Throughput automatically adjusts as data moves to cool storage to maintain hot-tier performance behavior.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GPT-6.1 Sol in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now generally available and rolling out in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it can be used for agentic coding and terminal workflows with strong multistep performance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Vector search and vector indexes in Azure SQL
item.description:
Vector search and vector indexes are now generally available in Azure SQL Database. The update adds CREATE VECTOR INDEX and VECTOR_SEARCH T-SQL support for efficient approximate nearest neighbor searches in AI scenarios.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance received late-September 2026 updates, including a flexible memory feature that lets you change the memory allocated to an instance without changing the instance size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Claude Sonnet 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Claude Sonnet 5.5 is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says it is intended for well-scoped everyday tasks such as building features and fixing bugs.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Private saved views for repository issues and “Relates to” issue relationship is generally available
item.description:
GitHub repository issues now support private saved views, allowing users to save personalized issue filters and layouts. The “Relates to” issue relationship is also generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: From Chatbots to Automated Agents: Routines in Microsoft Foundry Are Now Generally Available
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s Routines feature is now generally available, adding event-driven and scheduled automation so agents can monitor work, react to business events, and continue tasks over time instead of only responding in chat.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Sphere OS version 26.09 is now available
item.description:
Azure Sphere OS version 26.09 is now available in the Retail feed. This release updates only the OS; there is no SDK update, and internet-connected devices will receive it from the cloud.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enable and disable controls for Microsoft Foundry agents in Agent 365
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry agents can now be enabled or disabled from the Agent 365 governance surface in Microsoft Admin Center, and the feature is generally available. Administrators can control whether a Foundry agent is available for use across the tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Logical replication slot sync status metric for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now includes a new Azure Monitor metric, logical_replication_slot_sync_status, to track the synchronization status of logical replication slots. It is generally available and lets you monitor whether each logical replication slot is in sync.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PG18 support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support PostgreSQL 18. The update is available generally and is intended for new or existing distributed, cloud-scale workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: High-scale mesh in Azure Virtual Network Manager
item.description:
High-scale mesh connectivity with connected groups in Azure Virtual Network Manager is now generally available. In supported regions, a single mesh connectivity configuration can connect up to 3,000 virtual networks by default, with higher scale IP connectivity available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Ubuntu 26 generally available and latest migration
item.description:
Ubuntu 26.04 runner images for GitHub Actions are now generally available and fully supported for production workflows on x64 and arm64. The release notes also mention a migration update.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions generally available
item.description:
Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions are now generally available for GitHub Enterprise, organizations, and repositories. The feature lets you define an allowlist to control who can execute workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: TLS/SSL certificate and end-to-end TLS encryption support for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Azure Functions Flex Consumption now generally supports TLS/SSL certificates using a new site-scoped certificate model. It also adds end-to-end TLS encryption support for function apps in this plan.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent
item.description:
Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available. It provides a built-in Azure Copilot capability for investigating and resolving operational issues, and is available through Azure Copilot and Support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: User-bound user delegation SAS for Azure Storage
item.description:
Azure Storage now generally available with user-bound user delegation SAS, combining user delegation SAS flexibility with Entra ID user-bound access for stronger authentication. The update adds enhanced secure authentication for Azure Storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Playwright Workspaces in Australia East, Japan East, and Switzerland North
item.description:
Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing is now generally available in Switzerland North, Japan East, and Australia East. It provides managed cloud-hosted browsers for running Playwright end-to-end tests at scale with parallel execution.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: DRA Updates
item.description:
Kubernetes 1.37 adds several DRA updates, including GA support for extended resources, stable device taints/tolerations, and stable standardized NUMA node attributes. It also promotes multiple DRA features to Beta or Alpha, with focus areas including workload-level ResourceClaims, device metadata/status, scheduling performance, and fractional consumable capacity.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network Manager IPAM in additional Azure regions
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network Manager IP address management is now generally available in additional regions: US Gov Virginia, US Gov Texas, US Gov Arizona, China North 3, and China East 3.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Microsoft Defender for Cloud support for Azure Container Apps (Serverless Containers Posture)
item.description:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud now supports Azure Container Apps environments in its Serverless Containers Posture experience. This lets security teams manage posture for more of their container estate from one workflow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Artifact Streaming on AKS
item.description:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now supports Artifact streaming with Azure Container Registry (ACR) in generally available form. It is intended to reduce wait time when starting containerized workloads by allowing images to be used before they are fully pulled.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Set an expiration date for individual user budgets
item.description:
GitHub now lets you set an optional expiration date on an individual user budget. When the date is reached, GitHub automatically removes the budget; the feature is generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Purchase order mapping available in Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace purchase order mapping is now generally available. It lets organizations allocate Microsoft invoices, including Marketplace purchases, to support accounting and reconciliation of cloud and AI spend.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes
item.description:
Azure Firewall auto-learn SNAT routes is now generally available. It periodically learns registered and private destination prefixes and applies them as No-SNAT ranges to preserve original source IPs and reduce manual SNAT management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Observability Agent supports Basic and Auxiliary table plans
item.description:
Azure Copilot Observability Agent now supports Log Analytics data stored in Basic and Auxiliary table plans for interactive analysis and deep investigations. This extends coverage to high-volume telemetry in Azure Monitor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Monitor Auxiliary Logs Plan support for Azure tables and plan switching
item.description:
Azure Monitor Logs Auxiliary table plan now supports Azure tables and switching plans, and both capabilities are generally available. The plan is intended for high-volume, low-query logs used for compliance and auditing.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Storage Version Migration Enabled by Default
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 makes built-in StorageVersionMigration (storagemigration.k8s.io/v1) GA and enabled by default in all clusters. It lets administrators and CRD authors declaratively rewrite stored objects to the current storage version, replacing manual re-write scripts or the out-of-tree migrator.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles
item.description:
Kubernetes 1.37 graduates Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles to GA, adding built-in support for workload X.509 identity and trust bundle distribution. The feature uses Kubelet, PodCertificateRequest objects, and signer controllers to issue and rotate certificates for TLS/mTLS while keeping key material on the node filesystem.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure VM Image Builder in sovereign and air-gapped clouds
item.description:
Azure VM Image Builder is now generally available in Azure Government, China North 3, Azure Government Secret, and Azure Government Top Secret. The service can be used across these sovereign and air-gapped environments with the same managed image-building experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Bastion shareable link expiration
item.description:
Azure Bastion shareable links now support an administrator-defined expiration date and time. After expiration, the link can no longer be used to connect.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Connect to AKS clusters using Azure Bastion
item.description:
Azure Bastion integration with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available. It lets customers create a secure tunnel from a local machine through Azure Bastion to an AKS cluster API server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent VNet Integration is now generally available. It lets the agent operate within existing network controls such as NSGs, private DNS, and firewall policies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SRE Agent 30-Day Trial
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent is now generally available with a 30-day trial for new customers. The trial lets users create agents, connect operational tools and data sources, and evaluate the product at their own pace.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app Customize tab is generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s new Customize tab in the Copilot app is now generally available. It is meant to connect Copilot with a team’s existing tools, knowledge, and workflows, including MCP.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure 248 and 372 vCPU sizes for D/E v7 series VMs
item.description:
Azure has generally available 248- and 372-vCPU D/E v7 VM sizes in the Dlsv7, Dsv7, Elsv7, and Esv7 families, powered by Intel Xeon 6 processors. Microsoft says these sizes provide up to 20% better compute performance than prior Intel-based v6 VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: eBPF host routing in Advanced Container Networking Services for AKS
item.description:
eBPF Host Routing for Advanced Container Networking Services in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is now generally available. It moves packet forwarding and routing decisions into the Linux kernel to improve Kubernetes networking performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Custom block response code and body for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure WAF on Application Gateway is now generally available with support for custom block response status codes and response bodies for blocked requests. This lets you define the HTTP response returned when WAF blocks a request.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Summarized advertised gateway prefixes for route advertisement
item.description:
Azure Gateway now generally supports advertising summarized (aggregated) prefixes to on-premises networks instead of advertising every individual virtual network prefix. This is available for route advertisement in Azure gateways.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Databricks Lakebase in four additional regions
item.description:
Azure Databricks Lakebase is now generally available in four additional Azure regions: North Central US, France Central, Germany West Central, and East Asia. This increases deployment options and regional availability.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL added customizable keyboard shortcuts for Quick Queries, the Results Grid, and the Query Editor in Visual Studio Code. The changes can be configured directly in the editor.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
item.description:
Microsoft Marketplace is now a new channel for discovering, evaluating, and purchasing Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents. The availability applies to Dragon Copilot customers in the United States.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Control plane metrics collection for AKS with Managed Prometheus
item.description:
Control plane metrics collection for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus is now generally available. It provides native observability into key managed control plane components.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Live Resize for Shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Data Disks
item.description:
Live Resize is now generally available for shared Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks. It lets you expand disk capacity dynamically without application disruption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Batch rule updates for Azure Front Door
item.description:
Batch rule updates are now generally available for Azure Front Door Standard and Premium. The feature lets customers add, update, delete, or reorder multiple rules in a rule set as a single coordinated operation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Unity AI Gateway on Azure Databricks
item.description:
Unity AI Gateway is now generally available on Azure Databricks. It provides centralized governance for AI models, agents, tools, and MCP services, with controls for monitoring usage, managing costs, applying guardrails, and enforcing access control.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Explicit proxy in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall explicit proxy is now generally available. It lets customers configure applications and browsers to send HTTP and HTTPS traffic directly to Azure Firewall through proxy settings, instead of relying on route-based traffic forwarding.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Virtual Network routing appliance
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network routing appliance is now generally available. It provides private connectivity across virtual networks using specialized hardware designed for low latency, high throughput, and improved performance versus virtual machines.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Trusted Launch as Default
item.description:
Trusted Launch as Default is now generally available for new Azure Gen2 virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. It automatically enables Secure Boot and vTPM for supported deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Immutability to the most recent seven days of backups on Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance now automatically apply immutability to the most recent seven days of backups. The feature is enabled by default for all databases, regardless of the configured point-in-time restore retention.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Migrate from GitLab to GitHub with GitHub Enterprise Importer
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Importer now generally supports self-serve migrations from gitlab.com and GitLab Self-Managed to GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The feature is available through GEI and the GitHub CLI.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Single-click purchase for public SaaS offers
item.description:
Eligible SaaS products in Microsoft Marketplace now support a single-page purchase flow in the Azure portal. Buyers can review plan, billing, resource group, contact details, and terms before completing the purchase.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37 Sneak Peek
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 is planning several deprecations and a few feature graduations. Notable changes include deprecating kubectl run -f, forbidding Static Pods from referencing Secrets/ConfigMaps, starting deprecation of kube-proxy ipvs mode, and moving SELinuxMount to GA with possible workload impact.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog
